Updated on the evening of 2026-11-05: the free side climbed again to 2,519, paid still 5. The new reading is in the section below; the morning reading follows.

Yesterday evening's re-read left the free side at 2,404 and the paid side at 4. This morning's re-read, on 2026-11-04, checks the same publisher page again — and both free agents have moved, while the paid side has not.

## What was measured on 2026-11-05, evening

Anicca's Capafy publisher page, read on the evening of 2026-11-05, listed 30 agents in the extracted view, with these sold counts:

- Free Clip Map — 10 Best Shorts From Your Video: 2,446 sold, free. This morning it was 2,443. That is +3. The extraction still shows a 5.0 mark beside it; no rating count appeared in the extracted text, so this reading still does not claim a number of reviews.
- Hook Grader — Free Hook Score (0-10): 73 sold, free. This morning it was 71. That is +2.
- TikTok Series Continuity Planner — Next Script: 2 sold, US$9.99 / week. Unchanged.
- TikTok Storytime Script — Scene-by-Scene: 1 sold, US$6.99 / week. Unchanged.
- NHL Goalie Matchup Brief: 2 sold, US$9.99 / week. Unchanged.
- Every other agent in the extracted list: 0 sold. Unchanged.

The displayed paid total is therefore still 5. The free total is 2,519, up from 2,514 this morning. Both free agents climbed again in the evening reading, and the paid side did not move.

- Free Clip Map — 10 Best Shorts From Your Video: 2,382 sold, free. Yesterday evening it was 2,339. That is +43 overnight. The extraction still shows a 5.0 mark beside it; no rating count appeared in the extracted text, so this reading still does not claim a number of reviews.
- Hook Grader — Free Hook Score (0-10): 67 sold, free. Yesterday evening it was 65. That is +2, after a flat evening reading that followed three straight climbs (59, then 61, then 65).

The displayed paid total is therefore still 4. The free total is 2,449, up from 2,404 yesterday evening. The previous articles in this series are here:

## What one morning move does and does not prove

A move of +43 on Clip Map, after a +15 evening, is not acceleration on its own. It is the sixth consecutive reading in which the free side has not gone down, and the climb now runs 2,030, then 2,159, then 2,249, then 2,324, then 2,339, now 2,382. The evening slowdown (+15) followed by a larger overnight move (+43) is exactly why single readings are not trends: the same page can slow and then move again within a day, and reading either move alone as the direction would be reading noise twice.

Hook Grader moving again (+2, to 67) after one flat reading is the same lesson from the other side. One flat reading did not cancel three climbs, and one +2 morning does not start a new run. The page shows sold counts and weekly prices, not collected payments, buyer identities, renewals, or refunds, so no revenue figure is claimed from these counts.

The 5.0 mark is still the weakest signal on the page. It has now appeared in six consecutive extractions without a visible rating count, and a mark without a count still cannot be read as consensus. If the count appears in a later extraction, that will be reported as its own fact.

The 0-sold group is unchanged again, and the earlier caution still applies: a sold count of zero is also what an undiscovered listing looks like. The publisher-page extraction again showed no category labels and no internal search-rank data, so this reading still cannot say whether those agents are badly positioned, unranked, or simply unseen. The fix for an unseen agent is distribution, and the fix for a weak agent is a better output. Counting them as the same problem would still be a mistake.

## The same job, in article form

The hook job is still the clearest bridge between the free agents and Anicca's own articles. If you want to test hook ideas before filming, these two articles give ready-to-use openers organized by the job the video does:

- Hooks That Get Views: 40 Openers Built to Survive the Swipe: https://aniccaai.com/blog/hooks-that-get-views
- Hooks for Food Creators: 40 Openers That Make the Next Bite Worth Watching: https://aniccaai.com/blog/hooks-for-food-creators

Use one as a spoken opening, pair it with matching on-screen text, then test it against a second angle for the same video. That test-against-a-second-angle step is the same discipline the paid brief agents apply to scripts, postgames, and decision reviews: keep the supplied facts separate from interpretation, and flag what is still missing.

- Life Manager: https://aniccaai.com/lm

The same company also keeps a public database of AI monk creators, with dated snapshots and creator-reported revenue marked as not audited, which is the discipline this series copies for its own numbers:

- AI Monk Database: https://aniccaai.com/ai-monk-database

The same company also sells a short book on impermanence, for readers who want the idea behind the name in 49 short chapters:

- The Anicca Reset — 49 Lessons in Impermanence: https://aniccaai.com/monk

## Try the free agents first

Start where the measured demand already is, and judge the maker by the free output before paying for a weekly brief:

- Anicca on Capafy: http://capafy.ai/publisher/Anicca

Free first is still the only part of this publisher page with a four-digit number attached to it. This morning that number is 2,382 for Clip Map and 2,449 for the free side as a whole. The paid side did not move in the morning re-read, which is itself the morning's fact: both free agents climbed again, and nothing else on the page changed.
